notes.title: Fixed Tutorial Sound Bug
notes.content:
Fixed bug where if you completed the tutorial and then started it again immediately the narration wouldn't play.
Made it so that when you choose the menu button tutorial sound stops immediately instead of after a couple seconds.

notes.title: Tutorial Narration Update
notes.content:
Tutorial remembers if you've completed it in previous songs.
Tutorial voice over now split into multiple stages for lock and groove panel section.
Fixed bug where panels wouldn't recognize if you were looking at them and would disappear.
Expanded range of trigger speed to .2, 4
Haptics default to enabled.
Changed name "Lock" to "Dance Mode", removed the big red Xs that make you think you're doing something wrong and replaced with a particle system that matches the color of the current groove.

notes.title: Trigger Speed Slider
notes.content:
Added Trigger Speed Slider to the Gazebo to allow for user preference and customizability
 Added voice over to the tutorial
 Editing tutorial for energy to replace with a bar that goes up and down
 Changed groove selection panels so that they spawn around the four edges of the gazebo instead of right under you
 Added more dancers to Rave Gazebo
 Better colliders for environment in Xylitol Isomalt
 Cutout Lobsters in Antiparticle Lobster glitch out more slowly
